name: QUPPUQ Stock Token Toolkit
author: Qoo Radar

sections.description:
QUPPUQ Stock Token Toolkit displays read-only Stock Token reference data in WordPress.

It works on public front-end pages without requiring a WordPress login and can also be embedded in an existing member dashboard. It does not create a membership system, connect a wallet, request private keys, send blockchain transactions, or place trades.

Qoo Data Hub is the plugin’s remote data source. The plugin does not contact Robinhood REST endpoints directly. Historical series and 1D Change come from Qoo Data Hub and are not invented when unavailable.

Features

  • Public Stock Token market table with 10 rows per page and focused symbol lookup
  • Reference Price and 1D Change when sufficient history is available
  • Searchable Stock Token explorer
  • Single-token detail card with multiplier, contract address, price-feed metadata, and update time
  • Basic historical chart with 1D, 7D, 30D, 90D, and 1Y ranges
  • Qoo Data Hub read-only source
  • Server-side rendering plus JavaScript refresh
  • PHP helper functions for existing member dashboards
  • Fresh local cache plus stale cached fallback if the Hub is temporarily unavailable
  • No telemetry and no remote visitor-logo requests
  • Optional contract-explorer link disabled by default

Shortcodes

Market table:

[quppuq_stock_token_market]

Custom featured set:

[quppuq_stock_token_market featured="AAPL,NVDA,MSFT,AMZN,GOOGL,META,TSLA,AMD,AVGO,NFLX"]

Searchable explorer:

[quppuq_stock_token_toolkit default="AAPL"]

Single-token card:

[quppuq_stock_token symbol="NVDA"]

Optional contract-explorer link:

[quppuq_stock_token symbol="NVDA" show_explorer="1"]<h3>Advanced / developer integration</h3>

Existing dashboards

The plugin is independent from membership plugins. Existing dashboards can use the same shortcodes or these prefixed helpers:

quppuq_get_assets()

quppuq_get_quote( 'AAPL' )

quppuq_get_quotes( array( 'AAPL', 'NVDA' ) )

quppuq_get_series( 'AAPL', '7d', '1h' )

REST API

The plugin exposes public, read-only, same-origin WordPress REST routes:

/wp-json/quppuq-stock-token/v1/assets

/wp-json/quppuq-stock-token/v1/quote/AAPL

/wp-json/quppuq-stock-token/v1/quotes?symbols=AAPL,NVDA,MSFT

/wp-json/quppuq-stock-token/v1/series/AAPL?range=7d&interval=1h

The multi-quote route accepts at most 10 unique valid symbols per request.

External services

This plugin connects from the WordPress server to the external service below. Visitors’ browsers do not contact the service directly.

Qoo Data Hub

Service: https://api.qooradar.com/

Operator: Qoo Radar — https://qooradar.com/

Privacy Policy: https://qooradar.com/privacy-policy-en/

Terms: https://qooradar.com/terms-en/

Disclaimer: https://qooradar.com/disclaimer-en/

Purpose: Qoo Data Hub provides normalized Stock Token metadata, latest stored reference prices, 1D Change when sufficient stored history exists, price-feed metadata, and historical price series. Qoo Data Hub may obtain public blockchain and oracle data through its own infrastructure, but this WordPress plugin does not connect directly to Robinhood or Chainlink endpoints.

It is contacted when a Stock Token shortcode or plugin REST route needs uncached data, or when an administrator deliberately runs the diagnostics test.

Data intentionally sent: requested Stock Token symbol(s), requested historical range/interval, a generic plugin User-Agent, and normal server-to-server network metadata. The plugin does not intentionally send visitor WordPress accounts, membership records, wallet addresses, private keys, the WordPress site URL, or visitors’ browser IP addresses. The Hub naturally receives the WordPress server’s network metadata.

If show_explorer="1" is explicitly enabled by the site owner, the widget contains a normal external Blockscout link that loads only after a visitor clicks it.

Privacy

QUPPUQ Stock Token Toolkit does not collect telemetry or create user profiles.

The plugin stores temporary public market-data caches in WordPress. These caches contain Stock Token metadata, latest reference-price data, and historical series only. They do not contain WordPress user IDs, member profiles, wallet addresses, or private keys.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress Admin, or copy the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate QUPPUQ Stock Token Toolkit.
  3. Click Get Started on the Plugins screen, or open Tools > Stock Token Toolkit.
  4. Create or edit a WordPress Page or Post and add the recommended shortcode: [quppuq_stock_token_market].
  5. Preview the page, then publish it when you are ready.

The market shortcode displays a searchable Stock Token table with reference prices, 1D Change, update time, token details, and historical charts. No account or API key is required for the free version.
sections.faq:
Does a visitor need to log in?

No. Public shortcodes and read-only REST routes intentionally work without login.

Does the free version require an account or API key?

No.

What does Reference Price mean?

Reference Price is the latest Stock Token reference price supplied by Qoo Data Hub. It is informational reference data, not an executable bid/ask quote and not a quote for ownership of the underlying share.

What does 1D Change mean?

When Qoo Data Hub has a previous regular-session reference close, 1D Change compares the current Stock Token reference price with that stored previous close. Until enough history exists, the plugin displays an em dash rather than inventing a value.

Does the plugin trade or connect a wallet?

No. The plugin is read-only. It does not send transactions or request private keys.

Is this plugin affiliated with Robinhood?

No. QUPPUQ Stock Token Toolkit is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Robinhood.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public release of QUPPUQ Stock Token Toolkit.
  • Added public market browsing, focused lookup, single-token details, 1D Change, price-feed metadata, and historical charts.
  • Uses Qoo Data Hub as the plugin’s read-only remote data source; no direct Robinhood REST fallback is included.
  • Added a Getting Started admin page and a Get Started link on the Plugins screen for first-use guidance.

Older development history is included in changelog.txt.
